Source: R/espn_nba_data.R
espn_nba_teams.Rd

Get ESPN NBA team names and IDs

Usage

espn_nba_teams()

Value

A teams data frame

col_nametypes
team_idinteger
abbreviationcharacter
display_namecharacter
short_namecharacter
mascotcharacter
nicknamecharacter
teamcharacter
colorcharacter
alternate_colorcharacter
logocharacter
logo_darkcharacter
logos_href_3character
logos_href_4character
